points.statement: Tasks come from formative and summative co-play with expert players rather than synthetic prompts.
points.quote: tasks are elicited from formative and summative co-play with expert players

points.statement: Requests are normalized into parametric templates with explicit preconditions and dependency structure.
points.quote: normalized into parametric templates with explicit preconditions and dependency structure

points.statement: Tasks are paired with machine-checkable validators, and a bounded-knowledge policy forbids out-of-world shortcuts.
points.quote: paired with machine-checkable validators under a bounded-knowledge policy that forbids out-of-world shortcuts

points.statement: The harness records plan, action, and memory events such as previews, clarifications, reads/writes, checks, and repairs.
points.quote: The harness captures plan/act/memory events-including plan previews, targeted clarifications, memory reads and writes, precondition checks, and repair attempts

points.statement: Judgments are derived from in-world evidence.
The harness judges only from in-world evidence and uses lightweight memory.
points.quote: judges only from in-world evidence with lightweight memory

points.statement: The goal is a clean reusable setup others can run and swap different models into.
points.quote: The aim is straightforward: a clean, reusable setup that others can run, swap in different models

points.statement: Perception and action are restricted to public in-game APIs.
points.quote: perception and action are limited to public, in-game APIs

points.statement: A bounded-knowledge policy blocks admin commands, global map introspection, and scans beyond loaded chunks.
points.quote: a bounded-knowledge policy forbids admin commands, global map introspection, and scans beyond loaded chunks

points.statement: The agent gives a brief plan preview that splits the request into a few subtasks.
points.quote: The agent presents a brief plan preview that breaks the request into a handful of subtasks

points.statement: It asks a targeted clarifying question only when a slot is unbound.
points.quote: asks a targeted clarifying question only when a slot is unbound

points.statement: Judging relies solely on in-world evidence such as inventory and equipment deltas.
points.quote: judged solely on in-world evidence drawn from inventory and equipment deltas
